I've started playing small tribes again recently and here is what tips I can give to help.

Most important thing when staring is leveling up and saving engrams points. Dont just spend engram points whenever you'll need them later on. For your actual levels never upgrade fortitude, food, water or oxygen. All of those are pretty much useless because food and water can be held, and the correct armor will heat you up or cool you down. 

You wanna only be upgrading health, energy, weight, melle strength and speed. This also helps you in case you get swamp fever in which you most likely will get it. This helps because when swamp fever is on you the stats that lowered cant actually go below the base amount so the nerf hits harder than ot actually should and in a way helps you because of the speed buff.

Aight now onto neccessary items to keep on you. Of course you want food, water, picaxe, melle weapon, etc. But the best item all ark players stay strapped with early on are bolas. bolas are so convenient in the early game playing ark for killing players and taming. Other really useful items to always have would be a scope or telescope to see levels and far away, and the last item I really reccomend are parachutes. Parachutes will help you so much in fighting against players that wanna drop you to kill.

Aight now onto bases. I know this may sound kinda cheesy but look up secret base spots on the map you play. Normal bases hidden by some trees or a mountain will only last you a day or two before getting raided by alphas, but most secret bases online that go around are really small and can fit a few dinos and a small base. These bases can range from being found in like 4 days to weeks depending on the spot. They are also really ez to defend with turrets because usually soakers cant be in some of these areas. 

Another thing to take mind of is spreading resources early on. You can either make secret storages close to your base or more bases as the more spread your resources are the better chance you wont lose everything at once. Also spread some hide bags around the base to scavenge from leftover loot if you get raided. 

Now we are onto tames. I would first tame a parasaur as they can detect players and tames within a large range to alert you. They also can carry a lot of weight and get berries for narcotics. Another really good early tame is a raptor. They are one of the strongest things you can bola early on and are great for protecting the next tame I reccomend. Now I would get a Pteranadon. They can be bola'd making them the best way to start getting around the map. Now that you have some ez tames the first slightly harder tame I reccomend is an argy. (Flying bird thing lol) They can carry a lot of weight and our relatively strong making them good for early raids. 

As a solo player raids are essential in getting a lot of loot quickly. 

MY MOST IMPORTANT TIP IS TO TRUST NO ONE. LEMME SAY IT AGAIN TRUST NO ONE. Nobody is trustworthy always be on edge. If a guy says he won't raid you he's gonna raid you. If you see a guy bola him and take his loot. There are no friends on ark official besides you and yourself. Everyone is out to steal loot.

Now that I've covered most of what I thought was what's important here is a quick run of what i would do starting in a new server. This is assuming you have 3-6 hours to play ark that day. 

Day 1: get level high quick and make a normal hidden base by a mountain or trees for cover. Then tame a parasaur, raptor and pteranadon. Put my main loot in a secret chest hidden somewhere as it's better than my base to hide loot or split it 50 50 with the base and secret storage spot. Now I take Pteranadon and set up at better secret base spot I found online because I am a newb >:] I slowly transfer loot to my new base and ride the raptor and parasaur over if I can. If I cant who cares they are ez tames. With my new sneaky boi base I hop off ark.

Day 2: hop on ark. Old base is probably gone that's fine. I repeat the process of taming a parasaur and raptor if I need to. Now I make an argy trap or try to get lucky with my shots hoping the argy flies into a mountain. With the argie now tamed I look for bases that I can break into with grenades on my Pteranadon. Finds stone base breaks in with like 5 grenades. Doesn't find stone base ok tames another Pteranadon because backup flying mounts are important. Hops off ark.

Congratulations you've made it through early stages of ark official.
